service.description: Agent Code settings (plans/agent-code/10-Web-UI.md section 9) for a user with AgentCodeUse. kind client: the current user's, each stored one or its default (device settings answer their default; each device keeps its own). kind server: the environment's. kind schema: the names, types, defaults and stores of settings-schema.json.

Change Agent Code settings. patch maps names to values; a null value restores the default. Each name and value is checked against settings-schema.json, and an unknown name, a device setting or a value of the wrong type is refused before anything is stored. kind client changes the current user's (as UserPreference code.name, AgentCodeUse); kind server and kind policy need AgentCodeAdmin.
